column1: # Grape synonym table: <name as the API writes it><TAB><canonical name>
# Edit freely -- this is a versioned domain artifact, not generated code.
# Anything not listed here passes through with only case/whitespace tidied,
# so an unknown grape is never dropped. product_grape.raw_name always keeps
# the original, so a bad mapping here is recoverable.
# DELIBERATELY NOT MERGED (these look like synonyms but are distinct grapes):
#   Petite sirah  != Syrah        (Petite sirah is Durif)
#   Pinotage      != Pinot noir   (Pinot noir x Cinsault cross)
#   Auxerrois     -- ambiguous (red Malbec syn. vs. a white grape), left alone
